elements.element: The aggregate liability cap applies mutually to both parties.
elements.evidence: Section 21.1 applies the aggregate cap to “each Party” and expressly states that the cap is mutual.

elements.element: The cap is the greater of fees paid or payable in the 12 months preceding the claim and USD 1,000,000.
elements.evidence: Section 21.1 sets the cap at the greater of all amounts paid or payable by Customer under the Agreement and Order Forms during the twelve months preceding the event giving rise to the claim and USD 1,000,000.

elements.element: The exclusion of indirect and consequential damages applies mutually to both parties.
elements.evidence: Section 21.2 provides that “neither Party” is liable for indirect, consequential, and the other listed damages.

elements.element: Breach of confidentiality obligations is uncapped.
elements.evidence: Section 21.3 includes a Party’s breach of confidentiality obligations in Excluded Claims, and Section 21.1 excludes those claims from the cap.

elements.element: Breach of data protection and security obligations is uncapped.
elements.evidence: Section 21.3 includes breaches of data-protection or security obligations in Excluded Claims, which Section 21.1 excludes from the cap.
Section 21.3 includes indemnification obligations in Excluded Claims, which Section 21.1 excludes from the cap.
Section 21.3 includes gross negligence in Excluded Claims, which Section 21.1 excludes from the cap.
Section 21.3 includes wilful misconduct in Excluded Claims, which Section 21.1 excludes from the cap.
Section 21.3 includes fraud in Excluded Claims, which Section 21.1 excludes from the cap.

elements.element: Infringement of the other party's intellectual property is uncapped.
elements.evidence: Section 21.3 includes infringement or misappropriation of the other Party’s intellectual property in Excluded Claims, which Section 21.1 excludes from the cap.

elements.element: Customer payment obligations are excluded from damages subject to the cap.
elements.evidence: Section 21.3 states that Customer’s obligation to pay undisputed Fees for conforming Services is not damages and is not limited by Section 21.

elements.element: The aggregate liability cap applies mutually to both parties.
elements.evidence: Section 21.1 applies the aggregate cap to “each Party” and expressly states that the cap is mutual.

elements.element: The cap is based on 12 months of fees.
elements.evidence: Section 21.1 uses all amounts paid or payable by Customer under the Agreement and Order Forms during the twelve months preceding the event giving rise to the claim, subject to the USD 1,000,000 floor.
Indemnification obligations are Excluded Claims under Section 21.3 and therefore outside the Section 21.1 cap.

elements.evidence: Breaches of confidentiality obligations are Excluded Claims under Section 21.3 and therefore outside the Section 21.1 cap.
Gross negligence is an Excluded Claim under Section 21.3 and therefore outside the Section 21.1 cap.
